bugs.summary: polling only stops for succeeded or failed; a cancelled job is treated as still in progress, so the poller checks it every interval forever and never calls onFinished
bugs.repro: watch a job whose status is cancelled; the label says Cancelled but polling stays true and a new timer is scheduled every 2 s indefinitely

bugs.summary: any failed status check (including a transient 503 or network error) stops polling for good, so the chip stays on the last status (e.g. Running 40%) even after the job finishes
bugs.repro: watch a running job; one getJob call fails with 503; polling stops; the job then succeeds on the server but the chip keeps showing Running and onFinished never fires

bugs.summary: open() for a different fund resets the step, errors and result but not the answers, so the previous fund's company and terms are carried into the new fund's wizard and submitted there
bugs.repro: open the wizard for fund-1, type company Acme, close; open it for fund-2; the Company field already says Acme and Submit creates Acme under fund-2

bugs.summary: the stepper jumps to any step already reached without validating the current one, and submit does not re-validate, so after going back and making Terms invalid the user can jump to Review and submit invalid terms
bugs.repro: complete all steps, click Terms in the stepper, set ownership to 150, click Review in the stepper, Submit; an investment with 150% ownership is created

bugs.summary: Reset restores the default inputs but keeps openedId, openedName and revision, so the bar still names the old scenario and the next Save overwrites that saved scenario instead of creating a new one
bugs.repro: open saved scenario Base (exit multiple 9), Reset, change hold years, Save as 'Fresh'; Base is overwritten with the default inputs and no new scenario is created

bugs.summary: open() only asks before discarding edits when a saved scenario is already open; unsaved edits to a new, untitled scenario are thrown away without asking
bugs.repro: on a fresh bar change EBITDA margin to 40%, then open a saved scenario; confirmDiscard is never called and the edits are lost

bugs.summary: the stored queue keeps only queued and failed files; a file is dropped from the store the moment it starts uploading, so a reload or crash mid-upload loses it for good
bugs.repro: drop a.pdf; while it is uploading the store no longer contains it; reload the page (restore()) and the tray is empty and a.pdf is never uploaded

bugs.summary: retry calls upload() directly and the item only leaves the failed status after createUploadSession resolves, so a double click on Retry starts two uploads of the same file (and bypasses the two-at-a-time limit)
bugs.repro: a file fails; click Retry twice quickly; two upload sessions are created and completed and the data room gets the file twice

decoys.why_correct: watch() and stop() bump the generation and clear the timer, and every response is ignored unless its generation is current, so a slow response for the previous job cannot overwrite the new one and no timer survives stop()
save sets the baseline to the snapshot it sent, not to the live inputs, so edits typed while the save was in flight still show as unsaved; the saving flag blocks a second concurrent save
upload() never rejects (it catches every error), so the .finally always frees the slot and pumps the next file; failures cannot leak concurrency slots
